description: 【北海道】航空レーザーデータ(R02遠別川総合流域防災) [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 総合政策部. 北海道留萌振興局留萌建設管理部事業室治水課 遠別町 座標参照系 EPSG2454 JGD2000平面直角座標系12系. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 総合政策部. It offers 9 resource(s) in kml, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
